# Fetch all tasks from Today and Inbox projects, handling pagination
def fetch_all_tasks(project_id, token):
    all_tasks = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20  # max per API docs
    while True:
        resp = apis.todoist.show_tasks(
            project_id=project_id,
            access_token=token,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit
        )
        # Extract tasks from no_section_tasks and sections
        tasks = resp.get("no_section_tasks", [])
        for section in resp.get("sections", []):
            tasks.extend(section.get("tasks", []))
        all_tasks.extend(tasks)
        # Check if we got fewer than page_limit tasks -> last page
        if len(tasks) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return all_tasks
